::: {.atlas-caption}
Places analyzed with the [voting-bloc model](voting-blocs.qmd). Each of the sixteen statewide fits is colored by its precinct- or town-level voting blocs, from red (most Republican) to violet (most Democratic); points mark city and county fits; Maricopa and Pima Counties in Arizona, one joint fit around Phoenix and Tucson, are filled like a state. In California (30 blocs) and Washington (14) the colors rank each state's own blocs. Everywhere else they follow each bloc's 2020 Biden vote on one shared scale (2024 Harris vote in Maine), so neighboring blocs match across state lines. **Click any colored state or orange point** to explore its blocs. City panels rank each city's own blocs the same way, except the metro areas cut out of a statewide fit, which keep their state's colors: Seattle and San Diego (their county), Greater New Orleans (eight parishes), Greater Boston (MAPC's 101 cities and towns), and Greater Atlanta, Denver, Detroit and Charlotte (their regional councils' counties; North Carolina's only, for Charlotte). Phoenix and Tucson share one panel on the shared scale.
:::

```{=html}
<style>
.atlas-map { position: relative; width: 100%; }
.atlas-map img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
.atlas-hot { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
.atlas-hot path { fill: transparent; stroke: transparent; stroke-width: 6; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: all;
                  transition: fill .15s, stroke .15s; }
.atlas-hot path:hover, .atlas-hot path:focus { fill: rgba(255,255,255,.25); stroke: #222; outline: none; }
.atlas-hot path.active { stroke: #222; }
.atlas-hot circle.city { fill: transparent; stroke: transparent; stroke-width: 5; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: all;
                         transition: stroke .15s; }
.atlas-hot circle.city:hover, .atlas-hot circle.city:focus, .atlas-hot circle.city.active { stroke: #222; outline: none; }
.atlas-coverage { font-size: 1.1rem; margin: -.5rem 0 1rem; }
.atlas-caption { font-size: .9rem; color: #555; margin: .5rem 0 1.5rem; }
.atlas-panel { border-top: 1px solid #ddd; padding-top: 1rem; scroll-margin-top: 4rem; }
.atlas-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; }
.atlas-panel-head h2 { margin: 0; border: 0; }
.atlas-close { background: none; border: 0; font-size: 1.8rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; color: #555; }
.atlas-panel-sub { color: #555; margin: .25rem 0 1rem; }
.atlas-panel-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; align-items: start; }
.atlas-panel-grid figure { margin: 0; }
.atlas-panel-grid img { width: 100%; height: auto; }
.atlas-panel-grid figcaption { font-size: .8rem; color: #666; margin-top: .25rem; }
.atlas-blocs { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; align-self: center; }
.atlas-blocs li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2rem 1fr; column-gap: .6rem; margin-bottom: .8rem; }
.bloc-swatch { grid-row: span 2; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid #111;
               display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: .85rem; }
.bloc-name { font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; }
.bloc-meta { font-size: .8rem; color: #666; }
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .atlas-panel-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .atlas-state-map { order: -1; }
}
</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const show = (state) => {
    document.querySelectorAll(".atlas-panel").forEach(p => p.hidden = p.id !== "panel-" + state);
    document.querySelectorAll(".atlas-hot [data-state]").forEach(p => p.classList.toggle("active", p.dataset.state === state));
    const panel = document.getElementById("panel-" + state);
    if (panel) panel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  };
  document.querySelectorAll(".atlas-hot [data-state]").forEach(p => {
    p.addEventListener("click", () => show(p.dataset.state));
    p.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); show(p.dataset.state); } });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(".atlas-close").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
    b.closest(".atlas-panel").hidden = true;
    document.querySelectorAll(".atlas-hot [data-state]").forEach(p => p.classList.remove("active"));
  }));
});
</script>
```
